_meta.description: Round 9b af campaign: promote remaining mechanically-provable retargeted rows to manifest `contract` blocks (react-port specs). Baseline 142 PASS / 0 FAIL at server 85435473a. generate-manifest.cjs now PRESERVES contract blocks, so af-gate.sh counts them. Workers promote ONLY rows that PASS via --only; a FAIL row in the manifest breaks the fail==0 gate.

defaults.commit_style: parity: promote <rows> via react-port contract blocks (round9b)

tasks.title: AI-tab + view-tab panel/view buttons -> contract blocks
steps: Edit ONLY tests/parity/word-parity-contracts.json. Do NOT run generate-manifest.cjs. Do NOT touch other files.
For each token below that is still WITHOUT a `contract` key, add a contract block using the exact binding. Ribbon DOM ids: button=`#btn-<id>`, checkbox=`#chk-<id>`, select=`#sel-<id>`.

PANEL recipe (assertion via the Viewport marker): {"selector":"#btn-X","pre":"canvas-type","woTab":"<tab>","post":"","xfail":false,"assertion":{"kind":"dom-mutation","selector":"[data-wo-right-panel=\"<panel>\"]"},"note":"round9b <note>"} and set entry effektClass to "op".
Verify each token with: node tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs --only <csv> --results /tmp/r9.json  (--only takes a SEPARATE arg, space-separated csv). pkill -f contract-runner.cjs first if stale.
Keep ONLY tokens that print PASS. Delete the contract block from any FAIL token.

Bindings (token -> btn, tab, panel): btn-ai-assistant -> #btn-ai-assistant-panel, ai, ai-assistant; createaiassistant -> #btn-ai-chatbot, ai, ai-assistant; aisummarize -> #btn-ai-summarization, ai, ai-assistant; aitranslate -> #btn-ai-translation, ai, ai-assistant; airewrite -> #btn-ai-grammar-spelling, ai, ai-assistant; btn-speech/dictate -> #btn-draw-word-count is WRONG, probe the real speech button (cmd speechInput -> panel plugins), else skip; btn-track-changes -> #btn-track-changes, view, panel 'review' (assert .de-track-changes-panel OR [data-wo-right-panel="review"]); btn-view-headings -> #chk-navigation, view, probe; btn-view-darkdoc -> #chk-dark-document, view, probe assertion (dom-attr on <html> data-theme or dom-mutation .de-viewport).
If a binding does not PASS after 2 tries, DROP that token (do not commit a failing contract).

steps: Edit ONLY tests/parity/word-parity-contracts.json. Do NOT run generate-manifest.cjs.

StatusBar DOM assertion surface (apps/web/apps/documenteditor-react/src/components/StatusBar/StatusBar.tsx): zoom label = .de-statusbar-zoom-label .de-statusbar-label (text like '100%'); multipage = .de-statusbar-btn.de-statusbar-multipage.active; fit-to-page/fit-to-width toggle .active on their .de-statusbar-btn.

Verify with: node tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs --only <csv> --results /tmp/r9.json. Keep ONLY PASS tokens; drop FAILs.
Do NOT commit a failing contract (gate requires fail==0).

tasks.title: Keyboard chords with real document/panel effects -> contract blocks
steps: Edit ONLY tests/parity/word-parity-contracts.json. Do NOT run generate-manifest.cjs.

Chord contract shape (proven): {"key":"Control+KeyK","pre":"canvas-type","assertion":{"kind":"dom-mutation","selector":"[data-wo-right-panel=\"crossreference\"]"},"xfail":false,"note":"round9b Ctrl+K opens link/crossref panel"}. For pure document mutations use {"kind":"rev-bump"}. Playwright key names: Control+KeyK, Control+S, Control+Alt+KeyG, Alt+SemiColon, Shift+Enter etc.

Bindings: ctrl+k -> key Control+KeyK, assertion [data-wo-right-panel="crossreference"] (link command opens crossref panel); emdash -> key Control+Alt+Minus? NO — emdash is a shortcut token; check word-commands for its chord, else use rev-bump with pre canvas-type; endash, insertlinebreak already has rev-bump contract pattern -> if token still retargeted give {"key":<its chord>,"pre":"canvas-type","assertion":{"kind":"rev-bump"},"xfail":false}; ctrl+alt+g/e/r/t/q/= -> field-insert chords, rev-bump; alt+; -> rev-bump; ctrl+shift+k / ctrl+shift+space / ctrl+shift+minus -> rev-bump; ctrl+s -> key Control+S, assertion dom-mutation on .de-findreplace-panel is wrong — probe save (may emit event) else rev-bump; escape/backspace/delete -> probe, likely DROP if no observable DOM/rev.
Verify with: node tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs --only <csv> --results /tmp/r9.json. Keep ONLY PASS; drop FAILs. Never commit a FAIL contract.
